single.rationale: Nutanix has achieved a remarkable operational inflection, transitioning from consistent GAAP losses to profitability in FY2025 while demonstrating strong revenue growth (18% YoY), expanding operating margins (reaching 6.8%), and exceptional free cash flow generation (30% FCF margin). The company is well-positioned to capitalize on VMware customer displacement following Broadcom's acquisition, though execution risk remains around converting this pipeline opportunity into revenue given competitive dynamics and customer switching considerations.
